Threads is Meta's text-first app, but a large share of popular posts carry a video. Save-Froms reads one public Threads post link and returns the MP4 the post contains, usually at 720p, so you can keep a clip you made or one the creator allows you to save. Text-only posts and photo posts have no video, and the result says so.
